technology_name: Unified Digital Platform for Carbon Credit Estimation & Reporting
institution: KSCSTE- Centre for Water Resources Development and Management (CWRDM)
problem_solved: Fragmented, complex, and expensive carbon accounting mechanisms that prevent local communities, LSGIs, and small entrepreneurs from tracking emissions or unlocking climate finance.
description: A state-level unified digital portal that democratizes carbon accounting by deploying open-source, scientifically validated tools built on IPCC methodologies. The platform features localized, real-time calculators across five primary sectors: agriculture, forestry, energy, industry, and waste. It generates dynamic, traceable PDF/Excel compliance reports, calculates structural tree-planting offset metrics, and provides district-wide aggregation for green credit mobilization.
applications:
• Local Self-Government Institutions (LSGIs) for carbon-neutral panchayat audits

• MSMEs and climate entrepreneurs applying for international Green Credits

• NGOs and educational institutions executing accredited afforestation tracking

• State-level policy planning bodies structuring climate finance readiness frameworks
